# Historical towavue license

LICENSE-MIT preserves towavue's original MIT license text for versions before
1.0.3 and historical material manifests. Those versions were offered under
MIT OR Apache-2.0; their existing grants remain unchanged.

Current development toward 1.0.3 and later uses Apache-2.0 for towavue's own
code. See [LICENSE-APACHE](../../LICENSE-APACHE) and [NOTICE](../../NOTICE).
This historical file does not offer current changes under MIT. Third-party
components retain their own licenses independently of this transition.
